segments.speaker: dagna_holt
segments.text: The pens are quiet, and the boy is home with his father. That is enough good news for one day.

segments.speaker: old_maud
segments.text: The boy reached my fire, and I sent him home to his father. Poor old bear. A hundred winters, and the last was the coldest. Keep the claw; there is nothing else down there to carry home.

segments.speaker: old_maud
segments.text: I heard a fisher's boy is missing. I'll keep my fire ready if he finds his way here. As for that old bear... hunger wakes before a creature does. Go gently, if you can.

segments.speaker: dagna_holt
segments.text: A grey bear is taking goats from the pens, and a fisher's boy is missing. The cave mouth is below Maud's hut on the burned bank. Will you search for him and put an end to the bear?

segments.speaker: dagna_holt
segments.text: Aye. When the Hearth fails, the strong eat the weak, and everyone starves in the end. We have to find out what's happening to it.

segments.speaker: dagna_holt
segments.text: The Stranger knows. I see how they watch the road east. When the time comes, we make them talk.

segments.speaker: dagna_holt
segments.text: Twenty gold. My own. Now choose.

segments.speaker: halvard
segments.text: I had hoped you would turn back. I cannot yield the gate.
